name: services-page
description: Productized service offerings, pricing starting ranges, timelines, inclusions, FAQs, CTAs, and prefill behaviors.

# Purpose
Use this skill when building or updating the Phase 1 services page, pricing structures, FAQs, and service CTAs.

# Rules
- Render service offerings dynamically from data structures rather than duplicating markup.
- Keep pricing clearly labeled as starting ranges.
- Avoid making unsupported or speculative claims.
- Connect each CTA directly to the existing contact flow and prefill the selected project type.

# Workflow
1. Define service data structures (including 6 core services, pricing ranges, timelines, and inclusions).
2. Map services to components with integrated CTAs.
3. Wire CTA interactions to prefill project details in the main contact form.
4. Review FAQ sections and responsive layout integrity.
